project.name: MSL 18.5 kW Squirrel-Cage Induction Motor Digital Twin

provenance.frame_ambient_resistance: Calculated from MSL nominal loss and 90 C reference winding temperature; 20 C ambient; assumed winding-frame resistance
provenance.winding_loss_fraction: Calculated from MSL nominal stator and rotor copper loss divided by MSL total loss
provenance.safety_limits: Inherited Digital Twin controller envelope; not verified thermal limits for this unidentified motor
